checks.note: Both return the same 114-byte page: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><script>window.onload=function(){window.location.href="/lander"}</script></head></html> - a redirect shell to /lander, i.e. a parked/lander page, not a hospital website and not a CMS pointer. This matches the record's warning not to treat the redirect shell as a pointer.

Search results for the hospital in Fayette MS returned only third parties (AHD, US News, Nursa, Castle Connolly, Network of Care) and unrelated Jefferson entities in other states (Jefferson Healthcare WA, Jefferson Health PA, Jefferson County Health Center IA, Jefferson Comprehensive Health Center - a different FQHC at 405 Main St Fayette). No operating first-party hospital website was found.

established: As of 2026-10-01, jeffhospital.com serves only a 114-byte JavaScript redirect shell to /lander on both / and /cms-hpt.txt; it publishes no pointer and no pricing content.
